results.name: provider availability controls the real Google button
PKCE exchanges once and restores the real identity in page and header
authenticated profile updates use the SDK and keep the provider email read-only
a failed new code cannot succeed through an older stored real session
a missing or corrupt PKCE verifier cannot reuse an older session
sign-out ends the SDK session and returns page and header to the guest state

blocked storage still logs out the demo across remounts and explicit sign-in restores it
malformed stored login fields recover without a runtime error
